name: Dorothy
summary: A girl from a Kansas farm, carried to Oz by a cyclone in the first book and washed ashore near Ev in Ozma of Oz.

name: Toto
summary: Dorothy's little black dog.

name: Aunt Em
summary: Dorothy's aunt, the farmer's wife in Kansas.

name: Uncle Henry
summary: Dorothy's uncle, a Kansas farmer; she sails with him to Australia in Ozma of Oz.

name: Scarecrow
summary: A Scarecrow who wants brains; later rules the Emerald City.

name: Tin Woodman
summary: A woodman of tin who wants a heart; Emperor of the Winkies from the end of the first book.

name: Cowardly Lion
summary: A Lion who wants courage; King of Beasts in the forest of the South.

name: Wizard of Oz
summary: Ruler of the Emerald City, who turns out to be a humbug from Omaha and leaves Oz by balloon.

name: Glinda
summary: The Good Witch who rules the Quadlings in the South.

name: Witch of the North
summary: The good witch who greets Dorothy in the Munchkin Country and kisses her forehead.

name: Wicked Witch of the East
summary: Ruler of the Munchkins, killed when Dorothy's house lands on her.

name: Wicked Witch of the West
summary: Ruler of the Winkies, melted by Dorothy's bucket of water.

name: Queen of the Field Mice
summary: Queen of the field mice, saved by the Tin Woodman; her subjects pull the Lion out of the poppy field.

name: Guardian of the Gates
summary: Keeps the gates of the Emerald City and locks green spectacles on every visitor.

name: Winged Monkeys
summary: Monkeys bound to whoever owns the Golden Cap, three times each.

name: Tip
summary: A boy raised by old Mombi in the Gillikin Country; makes Jack Pumpkinhead.

name: Ozma
summary: The rightful ruler of Oz, hidden by enchantment until the end of The Marvelous Land of Oz.

name: Mombi
summary: An old sorceress in the Gillikin Country who raises Tip.

name: Jack Pumpkinhead
summary: A man of wood with a pumpkin head, made by Tip and brought to life with the Powder of Life.

name: Saw-Horse
summary: A wooden saw-horse brought to life with the Powder of Life.

name: Woggle-Bug
aliases: Mr. H. M. Woggle-Bug, T. E.
summary: A Highly Magnified, Thoroughly Educated insect who joins Tip's company.

name: Jinjur
summary: General of the Army of Revolt, who takes the Emerald City from the Scarecrow.

name: Gump
summary: A flying machine made of sofas and a Gump's head, brought to life to escape the palace.

name: Jellia Jamb
summary: A maid in the royal palace of the Emerald City.

name: Billina
summary: A yellow hen who is washed overboard with Dorothy and can talk in Ev.

name: Tiktok
summary: A clockwork machine man made by Smith & Tinker, wound up by Dorothy.

name: Hungry Tiger
summary: The Cowardly Lion's friend, who longs to eat fat babies but whose conscience won't let him.

name: Nome King
summary: Ruler of the Nomes under the mountains, who turned the royal family of Ev into ornaments.

name: Langwidere
summary: Niece of the King of Ev, who rules Ev in his absence and changes heads from a collection of thirty.

name: Evoldo
summary: The King of Ev, who sold his wife and ten children to the Nome King.

name: Queen of Ev
summary: Evoldo's wife, a captive of the Nome King with her children.

name: Evring
summary: Eldest son of the royal family of Ev.

name: Emerald City
summary: The capital of Oz.

name: Land of Oz
summary: The fairyland of the Munchkins, Winkies, Quadlings and Gillikins, ringed by deserts.

name: Land of Ev
summary: A kingdom across the Deadly Desert from Oz, where Dorothy lands in Ozma of Oz.

name: Kansas
summary: Where Dorothy lives with Aunt Em and Uncle Henry.
